interpretations: For each recorded patient sex, average aCL IgG and ANA across linked examinations, ignoring missing values separately for each measure; divide that sex’s ANA average by the unweighted mean of the per-sex ANA averages.

For each recorded patient sex, average both measures using only linked examinations where both aCL IgG and ANA are present; divide that sex’s ANA average by the unweighted mean of the per-sex ANA averages.

For each recorded patient sex, first average each measure within each patient, then average those patient averages by sex; divide that sex’s ANA average by the unweighted mean of the per-sex ANA averages.
Treat patients with missing sex as an additional sex group when calculating the averages and the ratio.
Exclude patients with missing sex from the averages and the ratio.
queries:
WITH sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.SEX,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
        AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> ''
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    avg_acl_igg,
    avg_ana,
    avg_ana / (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) FROM sex_averages) AS ana_ratio
FROM sex_averages

WITH sex_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.SEX,
        AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg,
        AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
      AND e.`aCL IgG` IS NOT NULL
      AND e.ANA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.SEX
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    avg_acl_igg,
    avg_ana,
    avg_ana / AVG(avg_ana) OVER () AS ana_average_ratio
FROM sex_averages

WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.ANA) AS ana_average
    FROM Patient AS p
    LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_averages AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(ana_average) AS ana_average
    FROM patient_averages
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT SEX,
       ana_average / (SELECT AVG(ana_average) FROM sex_averages) AS ana_ratio
FROM sex_averages
